_about: H. R. Hall (Harry Reginald Hall, 1873-1930), Keeper of Egyptian and Assyrian Antiquities at the British Museum. Classical scholarship, Aegean and Near Eastern history (lane B). Clean Gutenberg: History of Egypt, Chaldea, Syria, Babylonia, and Assyria in the Light of Recent Discovery, with L. W. King (1906). Raw IA OCR: The Oldest Civilization of Greece (1901), Days Before History (revised ed., Harrap, 1908), The Ancient History of the Near East (Methuen, 1913, first edition) and Aegean Archaeology (1915). Not taken: the British Museum guides and catalogues he compiled under Budge, and the excavation memoirs with Naville. US public domain. No uids minted.
